name: Renaissance Bali Nusa Dua Resort
short_description: A design-led Renaissance resort in the hills of Nusa Dua, Bali, with four pools, Balinese-theatre-inspired interiors, and a free shuttle to its shared beach club.
ai_summary: Opened in late 2021/early 2022, the Renaissance Bali Nusa Dua Resort is a roughly 307-room, design-driven resort perched on a hillside just outside the gated ITDC Nusa Dua enclave, on Jalan Siligita. It holds a 4.0/5 rating on TripAdvisor (ranked around #15 of 55 Nusa Dua hotels). Interiors by P49 Deesign draw on Balinese theatre and dance, giving rooms an eccentric, almost W-hotel character with soaking tubs, balconies, and bold color. Independent reviewers consistently praise the four distinct pools (the social Atomic 17, an artsy Jungle Pool, a long lap pool, and a kids pool), an exceptional Backstage breakfast buffet, the Lion X Chinese restaurant, a strong spa and gym, and warm, attentive service that skews family-friendly. The most repeated caveat is that this is not a beachfront hotel: it sits on a hill and runs a complimentary hourly shuttle to a shared beach club on Nusa Dua Beach, which some find underwhelming versus true beachfront rivals. A few guests also note the somewhat desolate walk from the gate to the main road and occasional inconsistency in rooms or service. Overall it reads as a well-rounded, good-value large resort.

pros: Distinctive Balinese-theatre-inspired design with spacious, quirky rooms and soaking tubs
Four varied pools that rarely feel crowded, plus a strong spa and gym
Highly rated Backstage breakfast buffet and diverse dining (Lion X Chinese, pool bar, beach club)
Warm, attentive, family-friendly service at generally good value
cons: Not beachfront: hillside location relies on a complimentary hourly shuttle to a shared beach club
Surrounding area is somewhat quiet/undeveloped, with an unappealing walk from the gate to the main road
Occasional inconsistency in room quality or service noted by some guests
research_highlights: Design by P49 Deesign / Carl Almeida themed on Balinese dance (Pendet, Barong) throughout lobby, bars and rooms
Four pools including the social Atomic 17 and photogenic Jungle Pool, plus Lava Land kids club
Consistently praised breakfast at the Backstage Food Theatre and strong overall value for a large upscale resort
research_watchouts: Frequently confused with the separate Renaissance Bali Uluwatu Resort & Spa; this entry is the Nusa Dua property (hillside, Jl. Siligita)
Marketed as a resort but is not beachfront; beach access is via shared shuttle to a beach club

faqs.question: Is the Renaissance Bali Nusa Dua Resort on the beach?
faqs.answer: No. The resort sits on a hillside just outside the gated Nusa Dua complex, not on the sand. It runs a complimentary hourly shuttle to a shared beach club on Nusa Dua Beach, roughly 2 km away.

faqs.question: How far is the resort from the airport?
faqs.answer: It is about 13 km from Ngurah Rai (Denpasar/DPS) International Airport, typically a 20-30 minute drive depending on traffic.

reviews.title: Review: Renaissance Bali Nusa Dua Resort
reviews.author: Raymond
reviews.summary: Detailed stay review calling it a near-perfect large Nusa Dua resort. Praises the eccentric 49 sqm rooms, four pools, extensive Backstage breakfast and warm service; notes it sits on a hill and needs a shuttle to the beach club.

reviews.title: Renaissance Bali Nusa Dua Resort, a next-level lifestyle experience
reviews.author: Linda Cooper
reviews.summary: First-person review of an Executive Suite with direct pool access and a round soaking tub. Highlights the infinity lap pool, gym with free juices, Lion X Chinese dining and Backstage breakfast, plus hourly shuttles to the beach.

reviews.title: Bali but not as you know it: designing Renaissance Bali Nusa Dua
reviews.author: Hamish Kilburn
reviews.summary: Design feature on how P49 Deesign's Carl Almeida themed the hillside resort on Balinese theatre and dance, from a Pendet-inspired lobby to a Barong-referencing R Bar, using lava-stone architecture, pitched roofs and walled gardens.

reviews.title: Renaissance Bali Nusa Dua Resort - Fun for Everyone!
reviews.author: Vira
reviews.summary: Overview of the resort's Balinese-dance-inspired interiors, four pools (Main, Lap, Jungle with a wedding venue, and Kiddie), Backstage dining, spa, kids club and roughly 310 rooms across two wings with garden or ocean views.
